description: Reads seven tabs with headerRow=firstDataRow=1 so the live column names come back as object keys, and censuses Communications outbound rows by delivery-key format.
why_it_exists: Two separate failures. First, idempotency claims were being checked against n8n's cached node schema rather than the sheet. Second, the WF4 outbound fix changed the delivery-key FORMAT: the duplicate-send check compares the new key literally against idempotency_key values already stored on OUTBOUND and OUTBOUND_PENDING rows, so any pre-existing row in the old format would stop matching and the block on re-sending an already-sent legal communication would silently lift.

snapshot.header_hash_algorithm: FNV-1a 32-bit over headers joined by '|', prefixed 'H-'

assertions: Setting firstDataRow equal to headerRow makes the header row itself arrive as a data row, which is the only way to see column names on a tab that holds no data.
That same convention means the header row must be excluded from the census by identity - a row whose communication_id literally equals the string 'communication_id' is the header, not data.
key_format_migration_safe is true only when zero rows have a direction beginning with OUTBOUND; a single old-format outbound row makes the WF4 key-format change unsafe to deploy.
The snapshot is evidence, not a verdict - retrieved_at records provenance and a downstream linter decides whether the snapshot is fresh enough to validate against.
Every node is a Sheets read; the workflow writes nothing.
target_unresolved_reason: kind is "integration": not executed by harness/run.js.
